head_target: head.png eroded by shared t; OpenCV exact L2 DT, levels 3..14 linearly interpolated for autograd
skin_target: raw/face skin minus raw/neck, largest component and hole filling; downward envelope below widest row
ear_target: Only manifest visible=true sides, image-left/right labels
shape: neutral + beta100 times identity-minus-neutral modes, then exp(logaxes); no per-vertex residual
camera: Orthographic; flip ICT Y, local pitch then yaw then image roll, scale and translation. Key affine composed into camera. Neutral facial-plane datum [0,3,9] converts initial translation gauge without image landmarks.
visibility: Numpy barycentric z-buffer at 720; camera-facing depth increases toward viewer. Contour samples attached to nearest edge of owning visible triangle. Frozen correspondence refreshed every 5 Adam steps.
ear_loss: Projected isolated pinna contour for target visible sides; report both full-head-visible and isolated IoU so model occlusion is explicit.
face_lower_coloring: The blue neutral y<=1.5 Face region is used by both L_skin and the reported skin residual. All triangle vertices must be in that region; then take its projected downward envelope.
thickness_prior: Start at 7px, constrain 3..14px. No extra thickness loss; beta and logaxes regularizers use specified weights.
